source: ARCHITECTURE.md §4 'Format → decay half-life'. 48% of the archive is from 2019; a global decay either buries half the library or resurfaces dead events.
target: engine.sites.ranking_weights -> 'decay' in the platform DB, written once per site by site:create / site:migrate and never overwritten (a site may tune it; §3.5 says Bali weights freshness differently).
contract: Consumers (E3.3 blender) read SiteConfig.ranking_weights['decay']. `half_life_days: null` with `evergreen: true` means no decay. `hard_expiry` names the timestamp after which the item is a hard filter (§8.A), independent of decay. `default` applies to a format with no entry (should not happen — the loader requires every format term to be listed here).

listing.note: series_key dedup keeps only the current year of an [Updated] set (§8.A)

opinion.note: proposed format; columns date like reviews do, not like guides
